correctness.rationale: Exact affine dimension and cospherical derangement vertices are directly calculated. The zero-margin tangent space decomposes into inequivalent symmetric and alternating pair irreducibles. The two specified conjugacy-class measures, with strictly positive explicit weights, have uniform center and scalar block covariances matching the dimension-normalized squared vertex radius on each irreducible summand. Thus their full covariance is isotropic. The Löwner contact theorem proves minimum volume globally and uniquely; strict convexity identifies all and only vertex contacts. The checker corroborates orders 3–7, without replacing the analytical all-order proof.

value.rationale: The canonical zero-diagonal Birkhoff face has two inequivalent nontrivial symmetry components, so its minimum-volume enclosing ellipsoid is not forced to be Euclidean by symmetry or by vertex cosphericity. A strictly positive two-conjugacy-class isotropic contact design proves exact optimality and complete vertex contacts in every dimension. It is a natural full-family metric invariant not supplied by earlier known inscribed-ball results.
